description: Generic Engineering Construction and Projects Limited engages in the construction of commercial, residential, industrial, health and leisure, and institutional buildings in India. The company offers architectural, structural, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing and sewage, fire protection services, building management systems, infrastructure works, procurement services, project management, and construction services. It also provides general contracting services, including core and shell construction, such as civil and structural works; internal and external finishes; roads and landscaping infrastructure; electrical, plumbing, sanitary, fire fighting, and alarm systems; and specialized services. In addition, the company offers project management consulting services. It serves renewable energy, industrial, residential, residential-high rise, commercial spaces, health and leisure, educational institutes, special projects, MEP and HVAC, government infrastructures, steel structures, pre-cast in-situ, and interior project sectors. Generic Engineering Construction and Projects Limited is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
